headline: Dangote's N$43B Walvis Bay Fuel Storage Project Hits Objections From Port Authorities
summary: Aliko Dangote's planned N$43 billion petroleum storage terminal at Walvis Bay faces pushback after Namport raised pipeline safety concerns and TransNamib demanded rail haulage prioritization.
why: The project is a major cross-border regional energy infrastructure proposal in southern Africa designed to improve fuel distribution logistics.

impacts.name: Dangote Group
impacts.why: Dangote's N$43 billion Namibian fuel terminal faces regulatory and safety hurdles from state rail and port operators.
